# Glossary

One rejection carrying two ignores: one the run still meets, one it no longer
does.

## Everywhere

### Includes

- `app/**/*.rb`

### Order

What a customer asks us to fulfil.

#### Rejected

- `Purchase` — Order is what the domain calls it.
  - `app/order.rb:2` — The line quotes the upstream column name, which is theirs to spell.
  - `app/gone.rb:9` — Kept past the line it was written against, so the run says so.
